scope: Recupero Debito English for Italian secondary-school years 1-3
purpose: Define what a learner must know, control and transfer in order to be considered prepared for the school recovery programme, before deciding which content needs to be built.
principles: Grammar remains a core part of Recovery, but it is one competence axis rather than the whole curriculum.
A learner is not ready because individual grammar topics were completed; readiness requires transfer across mixed and school-like tasks.
Every exit outcome must describe observable learner performance rather than only naming a language point.
Knowledge, controlled performance and transfer are distinct evidence levels and must not be treated as interchangeable.
Assessment mode and competence axis are different concepts: translation and mixed-school tests are ways to collect evidence, not language skills by themselves.
The student's official school programme can add, remove or move outcomes regardless of the default school-year profile.
CEFR controls expected language complexity, text length, task load and independence; it does not override the school's declared syllabus.
A readiness decision may contain blocking outcomes; high performance elsewhere must not automatically compensate for a critical required weakness.
Cumulative assessment must sample transfer, not simply repeat isolated topic verification items.
Content gaps are defined only after comparing required curriculum evidence with validated available content and assessment coverage.

evidence_model.knowledge: The learner understands or recognises the relevant language system or strategy.
evidence_model.controlled_performance: The learner can produce or manipulate the target when the task constrains what is required.
evidence_model.transfer: The learner can select and use the relevant language or strategy without being told which rule is being tested.
evidence_model.minimum_mastery_rule: An outcome cannot be fully mastered without at least one valid transfer evidence item unless the outcome explicitly declares transfer_not_applicable=true.

programme_override_policy.default_year_profile: Provides a robust starting curriculum for the selected school year.
programme_override_policy.school_programme_override: The learner's declared recovery programme determines the required outcome set.
programme_override_policy.later_or_earlier_topics: An outcome can be required outside its default introduced year when the school programme explicitly includes it.
programme_override_policy.optional_oral_components: Functional/spoken communication becomes readiness-relevant only when required by the school programme or selected assessment profile.

relationship_to_v1.v1_role: Legacy topic catalogue and grammar dependency reference.
relationship_to_v1.v2_role: Authoritative competence/outcome curriculum once year profiles and readiness policy are approved.
relationship_to_v1.migration_rule: Do not delete or rewrite v1 topic definitions during Curriculum v2 foundation work. Map existing topics into v2 outcomes later.
